# Cadence Lab

> Cadence Lab helps organizations improve customer experience by aligning workflows, systems, teams, and applied AI.

Cadence Lab is an independent customer experience and operating systems practice. The pages below provide a concise path through its diagnostic offers, operating perspectives, and practical resources.

## Diagnostic offers

- [Services](https://cadencelab.co/services/): Compare the diagnostic offers and choose an operating problem before choosing technology.
- [CX Systems Diagnostic](https://cadencelab.co/services/cx-systems-diagnostic/): Trace recurring customer friction through workflows, ownership, CRM signals, service rules, and cross-functional handoffs.
- [Lifecycle Risk Review](https://cadencelab.co/services/lifecycle-risk-review/): Examine lifecycle stages, risk signals, handoffs, intervention rules, and the data used to identify preventable loss.
- [CRM Workflow Audit](https://cadencelab.co/services/crm-workflow-audit/): Assess CRM data, automation, ownership, reporting, and the gap between configured and actual work.
- [AI Service Readiness Review](https://cadencelab.co/services/ai-service-readiness-review/): Evaluate workflow readiness, human oversight, data dependencies, adoption risk, and measurement before implementation.

## Operating perspectives

- [Solutions by industry](https://cadencelab.co/solutions/industry/): Explore customer experience problems in different operating environments.
- [Solutions by team](https://cadencelab.co/solutions/team/): Explore problems through the teams that own or influence the experience.
- [Solutions by use case](https://cadencelab.co/solutions/use-case/): Explore recurring operating problems and desired outcomes.
- [Experience Foundations](https://cadencelab.co/product/experience-foundations/): Establish the operating foundations required for consistent customer work.
- [AI Experience](https://cadencelab.co/product/ai-experience/): Connect applied AI to responsible workflows, oversight, and measurement.
- [Digital Experiences](https://cadencelab.co/product/digital-experiences/): Align digital touchpoints with the operating system behind them.
- [CX on Location](https://cadencelab.co/product/cx-on-location/): Examine customer experience where physical environments and frontline work meet.

## Workflow and AI guidance

- [Salesforce tracing](https://cadencelab.co/workflows/salesforce/): Follow customer work through Salesforce records, automation, ownership, handoffs, exceptions, and outcomes.
- [Cross-functional links](https://cadencelab.co/workflows/cross-functional/): Examine the handoffs and dependencies connecting customer-facing teams.
- [SLA escalation maps](https://cadencelab.co/workflows/escalation/): Map service commitments, escalation paths, ownership, and recovery decisions.
- [AI-to-human routing](https://cadencelab.co/workflows/agent-routing/): Define when automated work should transfer to human judgment.
- [Prompt firewalls](https://cadencelab.co/ai-tooling/prompt-guard/): Apply controls around prompts, context, and unsafe or unsupported requests.
- [Variance tracing](https://cadencelab.co/ai-tooling/hallucination/): Investigate inconsistent AI outputs and the conditions that produce them.
- [PII scrubbing nodes](https://cadencelab.co/ai-tooling/compliance/): Protect sensitive information as it moves through AI-enabled workflows.
- [Agent copilots](https://cadencelab.co/ai-tooling/co-pilot/): Support human work with AI while preserving accountability and judgment.

## Resources and policies

- [Insights](https://cadencelab.co/blog/): Read analysis about customer experience systems, workflows, CRM, service operations, and applied AI.
- [Free CX and AI tools](https://cadencelab.co/resources/ai-tools/): Use six practical, browser-based tools without an account, email address, or data upload.
- [AI Use Case Stress Test](https://cadencelab.co/resources/ai-tools/use-case-stress-test/): Test an AI use case against evidence, workflow, risk, oversight, and measurement requirements.
- [CX Handoff Mapper](https://cadencelab.co/resources/ai-tools/cx-handoff-mapper/): Map a customer handoff and identify ownership, context, timing, and recovery gaps.
- [AI Evaluation Builder](https://cadencelab.co/resources/ai-tools/ai-evaluation-builder/): Turn an AI use case into a practical evaluation plan with criteria, evidence, and review rules.
- [Customer Feedback Signal Sorter](https://cadencelab.co/resources/ai-tools/feedback-signal-sorter/): Sort feedback into signals, themes, evidence needs, and appropriate next actions.
- [CRM Data Health Sampler](https://cadencelab.co/resources/ai-tools/crm-data-health-sampler/): Review a sample of CRM records for completeness, consistency, usability, and operational risk.
- [Service Recovery Planner](https://cadencelab.co/resources/ai-tools/service-recovery-planner/): Build a recovery plan around customer impact, urgency, ownership, response, and follow-through.
- [About Cadence Lab](https://cadencelab.co/about/): Learn about the practice and its operating perspective.
- [System governance](https://cadencelab.co/governance/): Review the site's governance principles.
- [Privacy policy](https://cadencelab.co/privacy/): Review how the site handles personal information.
- [Contact](https://cadencelab.co/contact/): Start a conversation with Cadence Lab.
